text:
alex.w: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #7890? It switches the REST client default timeout from 10s -> 15s, and adds per-route override support. I hit a flaky streaming test in CI after the change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7890 :eyes:
mira: @samr this touches routing/timeout logic that shipped to Dedicated last week — any red flags?
samr: looking. The failing test is test_stream_ordering in streaming_client_test.py, reproduces locally with `pytest -k test_stream_ordering -q`. Quick stack snippet shows the client waiter timing out: 
```
E   TimeoutError: Stream did not start within 10s
```
so maybe something still using the old 10s default somewhere.
jordanl: Heads-up: changing default could impact a bunch of internal integrations. Suggest landing behind a canary flag and adding REDWOOD_LEGACY_TIMEOUT env to preserve old behavior for 1 week. Also add a changelog bullet under SDK/Breaking? (minor)
alex.w: good catch — I added a compat flag in the code but forgot to expose the env var. I'll push a follow-up that wires REDWOOD_LEGACY_TIMEOUT and updates the README + changelog.
ci-bot: linux/amd64 build passed — macos runner failed (streaming tests). 
mira: once you push that patch @alex.w, I'll do a quick review. If you can also add a small e2e that asserts per-route override is honored, we can canary this in staging. I'll ping infra for a merge window this afternoon. :thumbsup:
alex.w: thanks — pushing fix now, will mark the PR ready-for-review when CI flips green. If anyone wants to avoid churn, please leave quick notes in the PR thread.
samr: I'll watch the staging canary and surface any latency regressions.
jordanl: also add a line to the console release note about default timeout change — ops folks need to know.
alex.w: done — pushed patch and added env var + changelog. pinging for final eyes.
